notes.title: 23/01/2020 New mission: "Dude, where's my oxygen?" & bugfix patch
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30837263/2c175f14765f183701dab30f8f9d120549c8f37e.jpg

Astrocitizens, get ready for a new mission!

As the solar winds carry our space shuttles and tomato soup fills our bellies, we’re entering a new constellation. The space is vast, the stars are bright and they look pretty familiar… no, it’s not a hamster and it’s not a mouse, either. It’s a rat!

We’re celebrating the Lunar Steam Sale with a constellation worth of updates! Not only can you get 60 Parsecs! at 75% off during the sale, but there’s a NEW MISSION available FOR FREE!!! But that’s not all – Japanese language option has also been added! We even managed to squeeze in some bugfixes and balance changes this time round, too.

Here’s all the shiny details:

🚀 23/01/2020 1.1.0 Build 148 New content & bugfix patch 🚀

CONTENT

 New mission – Dude, where’s my oxygen?!
 New language option – Japanese


BALANCE

 Rebalanced the sudden-death events


BUGFIXES

 Missions menu cards are now clickable
 Gameplay GIFs can now be posted to socials multiple times
 Fix for Polish font missing a character
 Other minor fixes


Stay vigilant in space, good luck with the new mission and happy New Lunar Year!

Have fun in space!

notes.title: Balance patch #1
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30837263/3649bb2227c88681fb85d553d0509ee93a925ad4.png

Balance time!

As promised, we were looking into streamlining a few things to make 60 Parsecs! an even better experience - especially in regards to hunger control. The results are in!

This is the first of two balance passes that we decided to push for. The extensive list of changes for the first patch can be found below. The second balance patch will follow next week and just like this one will include balancing updates, bug fixes and other adjustments to make sure you may have the best time possible with 60 Parsecs!

Thank you very much to all those who reported their issues, shared their feedback and otherwise supported us as part of the 60 Parsecs! community!

Stay tuned for further transmissions!

+++ 23/09/2018 1.0.1.49 - Balance patch #1

- rebalancing of hunger and starvation enter/exit values
- rebalancing of soup value - rationing it neutralizes daily hunger drop
- rebalancing of soup value - rationing it provides a health bonus
- rebalancing of weak enter/exit values and first aid kit value
- rebalancing of hunger enter/exit values and change of its color coding
- rebalancing starving, hunger, health, morale and sanity values
- rebalancing of crafting upgrade costs
- rebalanced Emmet's Experimental trait
- rebalanced Deedee's, Maegan's and Tom's trait to affect the whole crew
- rebalanced team attribute events to favor bigger crews
- merged navigation and suit system into a single expedition system
- rebalanced warnings and frequency of sudden death story chains
- rebalanced traitor story chain frequency
- balancing pacing of "hard" events
- balancing flow of events with a high chance of severe, negative impact
- fixed logical issues in a few events with edge cases or missing values
- mutiny story chain review and fixes
- scheduling hello world event early on planets
- changed resource balance for survival games
- disabled crafting bug fix
- quest progression fixes
- text fixes
- visual layer fixes in survival
- gif saving optimization
- optimizations of screen transition

notes.title: Polish Version Coming to 60 Parsecs! Shortly After Launch
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30837263/1e24e0a8096fe85fab55c74fd55a0ed8846edead.jpg

As an indie studio, we do everything we can to pack our games full of content and meet the timelines we set. Sometimes though, the universe has other plans.

While we could lay the blame on that disconcertingly self-aware AI that infected our computers in orbit around Omicron-6, the fact of the matter is that we’ve run into a slight delay in our localization efforts for 60 Parsecs! and want to make sure you’re fully aware before the game launches.

Never fear, the game will still be blasting off on September 18th filled with all the deadly scenarios you’ve come to expect from a game with “60” in the title, but we will unfortunately have to delay the release of the Polish localization. Our first priority in the weeks following launch will be to complete localization of 60 Parsecs! in Polish.

Needless to say, we’ve learned our lesson - no more picking up unmarked floppy disks on scavenging trips.

Thanks for understanding! We can’t wait for you to get your first taste of the Atomic Space Age and promise that Polish localization is on the way. Stay tuned for more info coming very soon!
